value.rationale: The anticanonical nefness of a naturally defined smooth projective toric Richardson twelvefold is a structural birational-geometric question. The theorem classifies all torus-invariant curve degrees and gives 512 explicit negative curves, showing that the first three dyadic members pass from Fano (dimension 1) to weak Fano (dimension 4) to non-nef anticanonical class (dimension 12). It is a complete natural intersection invariant for the first nontrivial new size, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
